name: Tormus Deepforge

angles.text: Muren Stormpike directs developing warriors to Tormus Deepforge in Ironforge to prove their mettle and acquire a custom-forged weapon suited to their brutal calling.
Ironforge's master smiths frequently test promising Alliance fighters with hazardous tasks before crafting fine armaments for them.

faq.answer: Tormus Deepforge is an accomplished dwarven weaponsmith stationed at the Great Forge in Ironforge. He is capable of forging exceptional weaponry for warriors who prove themselves capable and courageous enough to handle dangerous undertakings.
Muren Stormpike, the veteran warrior trainer in Ironforge, sends promising fighters to seek out Tormus Deepforge when they are ready to craft a weapon suited to their advancing martial skills.
faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Tormus Deepforge?

faq.answer: Tormus agrees to forge a fine weapon, but requires a favor first. He insists on a perilous task that could well mean death, claiming it is precisely the kind of challenge an aspiring warrior seeks.
faq.q: What does Tormus Deepforge ask in return for making a weapon?

faq.answer: The task Tormus has in mind involves significant peril. Rather than deterring fighters, he considers deadly assignments the only proper test for someone worthy of wielding his forged craft.
faq.q: Why does Tormus emphasize that the job is dangerous?

faq.answer: Tormus Deepforge works near the Great Forge in the dwarven capital of Ironforge, surrounded by fellow smiths, anvils, and roaring smelters.
faq.q: Where can Tormus Deepforge be found?

faq.answer: Tormus deals specifically with warriors sent by their trainers, looking for individuals with the martial grit and resolve to undertake life-threatening errands.
faq.q: Which adventurers does Tormus Deepforge work with?

sections.body: Tormus Deepforge is a master dwarven weaponsmith stationed in Ironforge. When warriors demonstrate their growing prowess to Muren Stormpike, they are sent across the city to consult Tormus. Renowned for crafting sturdy, potent armaments, Tormus does not simply hand out fine blades and bludgeons to anyone who wanders up to his anvil—he demands that warriors earn his craftsmanship through action.
sections.title: The Blacksmith's Anvil

sections.body: Before Tormus agrees to strike hot metal for an adventurer, he extracts a promise for a favor. In typical dwarven fashion, he minces no words about the hazards ahead, warning that the chore carries genuine mortal danger. To Tormus, a task fraught with peril and the possibility of death is not a discouragement, but the ideal test of a warrior's mettle.
sections.title: A Perilous Trial

summary: Tormus Deepforge is an Ironforge weaponsmith tasked with providing martial armaments to promising fighters sent by Muren Stormpike. Before crafting any custom weapon, Tormus demands the adventurer undertake a perilous trial to prove their strength.
